data_fields.name: reward_xp_per_step
data_fields.donor_constant: '|'-separated list indexed by step; XP granted on advance and on finish from the last step's entry

data_fields.name: reward_money_per_step
data_fields.donor_constant: '|'-separated list indexed by step; money in copper

data_fields.name: drop_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: percent inside an 'item;chance' template on a kill or search step; zero refuses the step

data_fields.name: level_band
data_fields.donor_constant: MinLevel and MaxLevel from the quest row; both checked inclusively

data_fields.name: target_region
data_fields.donor_constant: region id of the step target; 0 = any region

best_idea: A quest is a per-character row holding a 1-based step pointer and a completed count, driven by a list of step definitions (type, target name and region, item, per-step reward); every event either moves the pointer or does nothing, and every bag and XP check runs before any grant or pointer write.
decision_why: Keep the per-character pointer and completed count, the step list as data, the precheck-then-grant order and the chance roll on a kill step's drop; reject the per-call reward grants, one-step-per-kill for counted kills, and the save order (rewards before the pointer reset, no transaction), because Frankendom needs one ledger posting that moves the pointer in the same write.
acceptance: A full bag or a zero-chance drop leaves the pointer, the ledger and the completed count unchanged; a finish posts one ledger transaction with every reward and sets the pointer to 0 and the completed count +1 in that same write; a counted kill quest of 10 advances only on the tenth kill of the named target in the named region (0 = any), with one pointer write per advance.
